purpose: Audit the first Newton-native residual controller-parameter adapter after real one-GPU one-hour training, while preserving the no-placeholder and no-T-Rex-promotion rules.

ready_gates.name: official_newton_scripted_infant_prior
ready_gates.evidence: Phase 02/04 Newton Panda hydro scripted lift-hold runs passed visual/lift/hold/slip/drop/contact gates.

ready_gates.name: real_mass_friction_grid
ready_gates.evidence: Nominal, ordinary grid, held-out scripted-feedback runs, and warmup15 source candidates apply real Newton mass/friction provenance.

ready_gates.name: held_out_generalization_cells
ready_gates.evidence: full_low and empty_high remain held-out evaluation cells and were not used for source labels or training.

ready_gates.name: formal_residual_label_source_runner
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_label_source_runner_v1_20260627_0455 passed fresh official Newton sanity and source gates with source_run_count=5, record_count=1800, total_feedback_trigger_count=1203, failures=[], generated_trex_fields=[], schema_promotion=blocked, and training_started=false.

ready_gates.name: residual_adapter_training_preflight
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_adapter_training_preflight_v1_20260627_0523 passed fresh official Newton sanity and input gates with 1440 train records, 360 validation records, held-out full_low/empty_high excluded, generated_trex_fields=[], schema_promotion=blocked, and no_model_created=true.

ready_gates.name: residual_adapter_trainer_smoke
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_adapter_trainer_v1_smoke_20260627_0539 passed fresh official Newton sanity and CUDA/PyTorch trainer smoke with optimizer_steps=3, checkpoint_written=false, and real_training_result=false.

ready_gates.name: residual_adapter_real_training
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_adapter_trainer_v1_train_20260627_0548 passed fresh official Newton sanity, trained for 3600.0302035808563 seconds on NVIDIA H200, wrote checkpoint checkpoints/residual_adapter_trainer_v1_20260627/residual_adapter_trainer_v1_train_20260627_0548.pt, reported optimizer_steps=32685, validation_loss=6.241170922294259e-05, active_accuracy=1.0, generated_trex_fields=[], schema_promotion=blocked, and failures=[].

ready_gates.name: gpu_utilization_monitoring
ready_gates.evidence: residual_adapter_trainer_v1_train_20260627_0548_gpu_utilization.json reports sample_count=120, mean_gpu_utilization_percent=99.08333333333333, max_gpu_utilization_percent=100.0, max_memory_used_mib=30233.0, samples_below_30_percent=1, and status=pass.

blockers.name: no_held_out_adapter_evaluation
blockers.evidence: The trained checkpoint has not been evaluated on held-out full_low or empty_high with fresh Newton sanity, visual/browser inspection, and lift-hold metrics.

blockers.name: no_controller_integration_evaluation
blockers.evidence: The checkpoint exists, but it has not yet been inserted into the Newton controller path and compared against no-adaptation/scripted-feedback baselines.

blockers.name: no_trained_policy_visual_gate
blockers.evidence: No visual/browser output exists for a rollout controlled by the trained residual adapter.

blockers.name: limited_source_coverage
blockers.evidence: Five ordinary source candidates were used. This is enough to proceed to held-out evaluation, but it limits broad learned-adaptation claims until more ordinary cells or object families are added.

resolved_blockers.name: real_training_not_started
resolved_blockers.evidence: RUN_MODE=train run residual_adapter_trainer_v1_train_20260627_0548 completed a one-GPU one-hour training run, wrote a checkpoint, and passed GPU utilization monitoring.

resolved_blockers.name: no_formal_residual_label_source_runner
resolved_blockers.evidence: Run residual_label_source_runner_v1_20260627_0455 produced a passing compute-side source manifest with 5 source runs and 1800 records after fresh official Newton sanity.

resolved_blockers.name: no_adapter_training_preflight_runner
resolved_blockers.evidence: Run residual_adapter_training_preflight_v1_20260627_0523 produced a passing compute-side training-input manifest with train=1440 records, validation=360 records, held-out full_low/empty_high excluded, and no model training.

resolved_blockers.name: no_adapter_trainer_smoke
resolved_blockers.evidence: Run residual_adapter_trainer_v1_smoke_20260627_0539 produced a passing compute-side CUDA smoke diagnostic after fresh official Newton sanity.

allowed_next_routes.description: First wire the checkpoint into the Newton controller path and verify a non-held-out validation rollout with fresh official Newton sanity, visual/browser output, and metrics.
After the ordinary validation rollout passes, evaluate full_low and empty_high with visual/manual/metric gates and compare against no-adaptation and scripted-feedback baselines.
Collect additional ordinary cells only if the first checkpoint evaluation exposes a coverage problem. Do not treat dataset mismatch as a reason to stop all progress.

next_required_step: Wire checkpoints/residual_adapter_trainer_v1_20260627/residual_adapter_trainer_v1_train_20260627_0548.pt into the Newton residual-controller evaluation path and run visual plus metric gates before any learned-adaptation claim.
